title: The cohomology pullback is induced by the unit of the derived adjunction
statement:
Let $u:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $u_*$ be the direct image and $Ru_*:\Dplus(Y_{\Et})\to\Dplus(X_{\Et})$, $Ru_*L=u_*J$ for a K-injective resolution $L\to J$, its derived functor [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions], let $u^{-1}:\Dplus(X_{\Et})\to\Dplus(Y_{\Et})$ be the inverse image on bounded below derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], and let $\eta^D_u:\mathrm{id}\to Ru_*u^{-1}$ be the unit of the derived adjunction $u^{-1}\dashv Ru_*$ [prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction]. Write $\RGamma(T_{\Et},-)$ and $H^q(T_{\Et},-)$ for the derived global sections and the cohomology groups [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Then:

1. (Leray identification.) For every bounded below K-injective complex $J$ of abelian sheaves on $Y_{\Et}$, the complex $u_*J$ on $X_{\Et}$ is K-injective; hence for $L\in\Dplus(Y_{\Et})$ with K-injective resolution $L\to J$ the equality of complexes $\Gamma(X,u_*J)=\Gamma(Y,J)$ (as $(u_*J^r)(X)=J^r(X\times_XY)=J^r(Y)$) is an isomorphism $\lambda_L:\RGamma(X_{\Et},Ru_*L)\xrightarrow{\sim}\RGamma(Y_{\Et},L)$ in $\Dplus(\Ab)$, natural in $L$.
2. (Alternative description of $u^*$.) For every $K\in\Dplus(X_{\Et})$, in particular for an abelian sheaf $G$ on $X_{\Et}$ placed in degree $0$, the pullback $u^*:\RGamma(X_{\Et},K)\to\RGamma(Y_{\Et},u^{-1}K)$ of [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] equals the composite

$$
 \RGamma(X_{\Et},K)\xrightarrow{\ \RGamma(X,\eta^D_{u,K})\ }\RGamma(X_{\Et},Ru_*u^{-1}K)\xrightarrow{\ \lambda_{u^{-1}K}\ }\RGamma(Y_{\Et},u^{-1}K),
$$

and so $u^*:H^q(X_{\Et},G)\to H^q(Y_{\Et},u^{-1}G)$ is $\mathcal H^q$ of this composite for every $q\ge0$.
